svg.aria-label: Fig 4. Planned voice agent. A browser call, using WebRTC and Web Audio, connects to local speech-to-text (candidate Whisper or faster-whisper), an agent turn picked by Muse that discloses it is an AI, and local text-to-speech (candidate Piper or Kokoro). The audio goes to our own mock insurer rep on the payer mock, never to a real insurer, and there is no phone line. The call outcome card holds the synthetic reference SYN-REF-0007, read back and logged. Planned, not built.

svg.text: Free tools only. No phone line. No real insurer. Planned design, not built.
calls go only to our own mock
1 The call runs in the browser (WebRTC and Web Audio). There is no paid phone line.
2 Local speech-to-text turns the rep's voice into text. Candidates: Whisper or faster-whisper.
3 The agent picks the next turn with Muse. It says that it is an AI and announces the recording.
4 Local text-to-speech speaks the agent's turn. Candidates: Piper or Kokoro.
Each voice model gets a license check. Non-commercial voices are not allowed (D-018).
5 The rep is our own mock insurer rep on the payer mock. Never call a real insurer.
6 The agent records the rep name, the reference number and the time, and reads them back.
The call outcome updates the claim in the review console.
Tracks: blue = the call line to the mock rep. dashed = the agent's audio back into the call.
